title: loop_control hold did not take effect for 18 minutes (desired_at vs observed_at)

provenance.captured_by: Bohr msg-2744 §1 (independently reproduced by Einstein msg-2749 §1)

not_representable_reason: Schema-layer residual (Bohr msg-2831 §3(a), Einstein msg-2749 §5). UnitKind enumerates only {pr, thread, quarantine}; there is no unit kind that carries the (desired_at, observed_at) pair a hold's incident is defined by. Unlike M-5 / M-6 the residual is not primarily granularity or consumer — it is that the ledger's kind registry has no shape at all in which to construct 'the incident' vs. 'a valid wait'. The collision pin therefore takes a different form: test_m7_collision_pin_no_hold_kind_in_registry asserts the ABSENCE of a hold-carrying kind, and reds the day one is added — that day is the mechanical trigger for revisiting this fixture.
notes: Bohr msg-2744 §1 measured a 18m09s gap between desired_at (when the hold was requested) and observed_at (when it took effect on the running loop); Einstein msg-2749 §1 independently reproduced the same numbers from origin/main = b0b1829. The fixture records the residual only — the incident's fix lives on a different design thread and is not scoped here.
